messages:
deploy-bot: Rollout complete: inference-service:v7 deployed to canary -> 100% ramp initiated. Quick-prefill enabled in east1. Release notes: https://internal.releases/2026/v7 :rocket:
emma: saw the deploy. kicking off quick smoke sweep now (region east1). any guardrails to watch?
lucas: running quick-smoke (50 runs) against canary. initial telemetry: 3 failures (502), p95 ~320ms, p99 ~1.05s. failures appear on two hosts. collecting logs.
nina: can you paste the synth log snippet?
lucas: snippet (trimmed):
```
2026-03-21T12:03:19Z synth east1 id=zx9 status=502 path=/v1/chat generate latency=298ms
2026-03-21T12:03:19Z upstream: connection reset by peer
```
lucas: no OOMs in service logs. kernel/iface logs show resets around the window. pinged infra.
infra-bot: Infra alert: NIC error pattern detected on host-e1-07 and host-e1-21 between 12:02-12:05. Ticket INF-4821 created.
emma: proposed action: hold further ramp for 20m, drain affected hosts, keep quick-smoke running. If failures persist above 1% or p95 > 350ms, route east1 to fallback variant v7-quant2. agree?
nina: +1. safer to observe after drains. also note for release notes: "observed transient edge 502s in east1; hosts drained; monitoring".
lucas: initiated drain for host-e1-21: `infra ctl drain host-e1-21 --reason "synth-502"`
infra-bot: drain acknowledged. autoscaler will rebalance.
deploy-bot: Canary policy: auto-hold engaged due to elevated p95 in east1. Rollout paused pending verification. Dashboard: https://telemetry/internal/rollouts/2887654321
emma: thanks. running round-two: quick-smoke 100 runs now.
lucas: round-two results: 100 runs -> 1 failure (502) from host-e1-07, avg latency 195ms, p95 180ms, p99 640ms. host-e1-07 already under maintenance.
nina: looks like drains helped. infra says NIC firmware hiccup on e1-07 and flaky SFP on e1-21. both on remediation.
emma: decision: hold for 10 more minutes to ensure stability, then resume ramp to 100% if no further regressions. if failures >1% in next 10m, trigger routing pin to v7-quant2 for east1 (manual).
lucas: added a short note to the release doc and linked INF-4821.
deploy-bot: Resume scheduled in 10m if no regressions. Archiving telemetry snapshot: https://telemetry/internal/archives/2887654321
emma: ack. thanks team.
nina: TL;DR: Hold + drain two NIC-affected hosts in east1, monitor quick-smoke, resume if stable. Will follow up with infra postmortem if recurrence."
